scheme_name: Long Term-Loan to SC Co-op Spinning Mills under Special Component Plan
other_conditions: Spinning mill must collect a minimum of ₹80,00,000 or at least 5% of the project cost as member shares
Project must be enumerated by recognized financial institutions/banks (e.g., MITCON, Agriculture Financial Corporation, Dattajirao Technical Institute)
Engage with recognized institutions early in the project planning phase to facilitate enumeration
benefits_summary: Loan covering 50% of the project cost.
